# Project Phoenix v15.0: targeted REPLACE overrides for vanilla generic_actions (tatar_yoke.txt retired with 0 functional diff).
# Generated from EU5 1.4.9 vanilla definitions; do not edit by hand.

# --- From in_game/common/generic_actions/bureaucracy_actions.txt (2 blocks) ---
REPLACE:add_bureaucracy_action = {
	type = owncountry
	
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes }
		scope:actor = {
			any_current_bureaucracy = { count < scope:actor.max_bureaucracy_slots }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes }
	}

	price = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target_bureaucracy
			}
			scope:target_bureaucracy = {
				value = "implementation_price(scope:actor)"
			}
		}
	}
	price_modifier = {
		add = {
			value = 1
			desc = BASE_VALUE
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_bureaucracy }
			divide = {
				desc = "MODIFIER_TYPE_NAME_global_bureaucracy_implementation_efficiency"
				value = 1
				add = scope:actor.modifier:global_bureaucracy_implementation_efficiency
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = bureaucracy_type
		source = actor
		target_flag = target_bureaucracy
		name = "select_bureaucracy"
		none_available_msg_key = "no_bureaucracies_available"
		default_sort = name
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = negative_modifiers }
		column = { data = constant_modifiers }
		column = { data = positive_modifiers }
		visible = {
			scope:actor = {
				not = { 
					has_bureaucracy_of_type = root
				}
				bureaucracy_type_is_visible = root
			}
		}
		enabled = {
			scope:actor = {
				bureaucracy_type_is_enabled = root
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_bureaucracy }
			scope:actor = { add_bureaucracy = scope:target_bureaucracy }
		}
	}
	
	ai_will_do = {
		value = -1 #handled in code
	}
}

REPLACE:remove_bureaucracy_action = {
	allow = { scope:actor = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } }

	type = owncountry
	
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes }
		scope:actor = {
			any_current_bureaucracy = { count > 0 }
		}
	}

	price = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target_bureaucracy
			}
			scope:target_bureaucracy = {
				value = "removal_price(scope:actor)"
			}
		}
	}
	price_modifier = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_bureaucracy }
			add = {
				value = scope:target_bureaucracy.removal_price_modifier
				desc = "[target_bureaucracy.GetName]"
			}
		}
		else = {
			add = {
				value = 1
				desc = BASE_VALUE
			}
			divide = {
				desc = "MODIFIER_TYPE_NAME_global_bureaucracy_removal_efficiency"
				value = 1
				add = scope:actor.modifier:global_bureaucracy_removal_efficiency
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = bureaucracy
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_current_bureaucracy = { 
					add_to_list = source 
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = target_bureaucracy
		name = "select_bureaucracy"
		none_available_msg_key = "no_bureaucracies_available"
		column = { data = name }
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_bureaucracy }
			scope:actor = {
				every_current_bureaucracy = {
					limit = { bureaucracy_type = scope:target_bureaucracy.bureaucracy_type }
					scope:actor = { remove_bureaucracy = prev }
				}
			}
		}
		else = { scope:actor = { add_prestige = 5 }}
	}
	
	ai_will_do = {
		value = -1 #handled in code
	}
}

# --- From in_game/common/generic_actions/culture.txt (3 blocks) ---
REPLACE:add_accepted_culture = {
	type = owncountry

	potential = {
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			in_civil_war = no
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:actor
			}
			scope:actor = {
				culture_population_in_country = {
					culture = scope:target
					value > 0
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_tick = never
	ai_tick_frequency = 12

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = cultureacceptance

	price = price:add_accepted_culture

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = culture
		target_flag = target
		source = actor
		source_flags = only_tolerated

		name = "add_accepted_culture_select_culture"
		none_available_msg_key = "add_accepted_culture_no_cultures"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
			not = { is_accepted_in = scope:actor }
		}
		enabled = {
			is_tolerated_in = scope:actor
			NOT = {
				scope:actor.culture = this
			}
			# Full acceptance has no minimum population/percentage requirement in Project Phoenix.
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:target
				}
				add_accepted_culture = scope:target
				grant_culture_bonus_advances = scope:target
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		# handled in code
	}
}

REPLACE:change_primary_culture = {
	type = owncountry

	potential = {
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = {
                text = OE_PRIMARY_CULTURE_CHANGE_PERMITTED
                modifier:oe_block_primary_culture_change = no
            }
			is_colonial_subject = no
			in_civil_war = no
		}
	}

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1

	price = price:change_primary_culture

	cooldown = {
		type = convert_culture
		years = 10
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = culture
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "change_culture_select_culture"
		none_available_msg_key = "change_primary_culture_no_cultures"

		ai_interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = dominant_culture }
					dominant_culture = {
						add_to_list = source
					}
				}
				else = {
					culture = {
						add_to_list = source
					}
				}
			}
		}

		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					has_game_rule = dynamic_culture
				}
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_game_rule = culture_group_only
				}
				scope:actor = {
					culture = {
						any_culture_group = {
							root = {
								has_culture_group = prev
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_game_rule = culture_present_in_country
				}
				scope:actor = {
					culture_population_in_country = {
						culture = root
						value > 0
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_else = {
				always = yes
			}
		}
		enabled = {
            scope:actor = {
                custom_tooltip = {
                    text = OE_PRIMARY_CULTURE_CHANGE_PERMITTED
                    modifier:oe_block_primary_culture_change = no
                }
            }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					has_game_rule = dynamic_culture
				}
				scope:actor = {
					has_accepted_culture = root
					not = { culture = root }
					OR = {
						dominant_culture ?= root
						ruler ?= { culture = root }
						dominant_upper_class_culture ?= root
					}
				}
			}
			can_change_primary_culture = {
				country = scope:actor
				culture = root
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
                    modifier:oe_block_primary_culture_change = no
					exists = scope:target
				}
				culture = {
					save_scope_as = old_culture
				}
				change_culture = scope:target
				add_accepted_culture = scope:old_culture
				grant_culture_bonus_advances = scope:target
			}
		}
	}
	
	ai_will_do = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					at_war = yes
				}
			}
			multiply = 0
		}

		# change our primiary culture if it is 10% bigger than our current one and we are at peace
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					"culture_percentage_in_country(scope:target)" > { value = "culture_percentage_in_country(scope:actor.culture)" add = 0.1 }
				}
			}
			add = 1000
		}

		subtract = {
			desc = "less accepted pops"
			scope:actor = {
				value = 100
				multiply = "culture_percentage_in_country(scope:target)"
			}
		}
		
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					ruler ?= { culture = scope:actor.culture }
				}
			}
			multiply = 0
		}

		if = {
			limit = { 
				has_game_rule = historical_ai_choices
				scope:actor = {
					has_or_had_tag = TUR
				}
			}

			add = {
				desc = "historical ottomans"
				value = -10000
			}
		}
		
		add = {
			desc = "inertia"
			value = -1
		}

	}
}

REPLACE:add_tolerated_culture = {
	type = owncountry

	potential = {
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			in_civil_war = no
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:actor
			}
			scope:actor = {
				culture_population_in_country = {
					culture = scope:target
					value > 0
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_tick = never
	ai_tick_frequency = 12

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = cultureacceptance
	
	price = price:add_tolerated_culture

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = culture
		#for the AI we have an optimisation to only look through cultures that are present. Human can look at all...but will have some disabled
		source_ai_override = actor
		target_flag = target
		source_flags_ai_override = include_any_present
		name = "add_tolerated_culture_select_culture"
		none_available_msg_key = "add_tolerated_culture_no_cultures"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		enabled = {
			NOR = {
				scope:actor.culture = this
				is_tolerated_in = scope:actor
				is_accepted_in = scope:actor
			}
			scope:actor = {
				OR = {
					culture_percentage_in_country = {
						culture = root
						value >= 0.001
					}


					culture_population_in_country = {
						culture = root
						value >= 10
					}
					any_estate = {
						dominant_culture ?= { this = root }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:target
				}
				add_tolerated_culture = scope:target
			}
		}
	}
	
	ai_will_do = {
		# handled in code
	}
}

# --- From in_game/common/generic_actions/hussite_wars_actions.txt (2 blocks) ---
REPLACE:align_with_moderates_help_hw_action = {
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 6

	automation_tick = never
	automation_tick_frequency = 12

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { religion = religion:catholic }	#Only Hussites, Catholics and Bohemia see the situation, so it is fine
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_neighbor_country = {
				NOT = { religion = prev.religion }
				NOR = {
					is_at_war_with = prev
					is_rival_of = prev
					is_enemy_of = prev
					AND = {
						country_exists = international_organization:hre.leader_country
						OR = {
							has_mutual_scripted_relation = {
								type = relation_type:alliance
								target = international_organization:hre.leader_country
							}
							is_subject_of = international_organization:hre.leader_country
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	price = price:hussite_wars_actions_price

	cooldown = {
		type = align_with_moderates_help_hw_action
		years = 3
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
			situation:hussite_wars = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}

	effect = { 
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { 
					has_country_modifier = promoted_radicals_modifier
				}
				remove_country_modifier = promoted_radicals_modifier
			}
			ordered_neighbor_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { religion = prev.religion }
					NOR = {
						is_at_war_with = prev
						is_rival_of = prev
						is_enemy_of = prev
						AND = {
							country_exists = international_organization:hre.leader_country
							OR = {
								has_mutual_scripted_relation = {
									type = relation_type:alliance
									target = international_organization:hre.leader_country
								}
								is_subject_of = international_organization:hre.leader_country
							}
						}
						has_mutual_scripted_relation = {
							type = relation_type:alliance
							target = prev
						}
						is_subject_of = prev
					}
				}
				order_by = total_population
				max = 3
				check_range_bounds = no
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:actor
					modifier = opinion_religious_outreach_during_the_hussite_wars_modifier
				}
			}
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = promoted_moderates_modifier
				years = modifier_duration_years_very_short
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = countries_less_likely_to_join_against_us_tt
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -1
		if = {
			limit = { 
				scope:actor ?= { at_war = no }
			}
			add = 5
		}
		else = { add = -100 }
	}
}

REPLACE:align_with_radicals_help_hw_action = {
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { religion = religion:catholic }	#Only Hussites, Catholics and Bohemia see the situation, so it is fine
		}
	}

	allow = {
		
	}
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 4

	automation_tick = never
	automation_tick_frequency = 12
	price = price:hussite_wars_actions_price

	cooldown = {
		type = demand_noble_donations_hw_action
		years = 3
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
			situation:hussite_wars = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}

	effect = { 
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { 
					has_country_modifier = promoted_moderates_modifier
				}
				remove_country_modifier = promoted_moderates_modifier
			}
			ordered_neighbor_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { religion = prev.religion }
					NOR = {
						is_at_war_with = prev
						is_rival_of = prev
						is_enemy_of = prev
						AND = {
							country_exists = international_organization:hre.leader_country
							OR = {
								has_mutual_scripted_relation = {
									type = relation_type:alliance
									target = international_organization:hre.leader_country
								}
								is_subject_of = international_organization:hre.leader_country
							}
						}
						has_mutual_scripted_relation = {
							type = relation_type:alliance
							target = prev
						}
						is_subject_of = prev
					}
				}
				order_by = total_population
				max = 5
				check_range_bounds = no
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:actor
					modifier = opinion_religious_radicalism_during_the_hussite_wars
				}
			}
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = promoted_radicals_modifier
				years = modifier_duration_years_very_short
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = countries_more_likely_to_join_against_us_tt
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -1
		if = {
			limit = { 
				scope:actor ?= { at_war = yes }
			}
			add = 5
		}
		else = { add = -100 }
	}
}
